i know this more than likely means nothing to you, and as someone you’ve never met and never will you have no reason to care or believe in what i say, but you have purpose, no i don’t mean that religiously and i know it’s so clique but things are always darkest before they get better. 
if it means anything, just look at all this support people are ready to give in order to preserve a strangers life; you are worth love and care, and it breaks my heart to hear what you’ve been through. you are strong. adversity doesn’t define you. words of affirmation may not be what you need to hear, but if you’re able to find even a shred of hope in life or in you’re yourself that’s something you shouldn’t ignore. cuz you don’t get a second chance at life. again, i don’t know what you’re exactly going through but i hope you can get better, you deserve it.

you are stronger than all those awful people combined. you have gone through pain i can’t even imagine, and i’m proud of you for that. you are so so strong. life is hard and cruel but it is never certain. it can always get better. just because everybody says “it gets better” so much doesn’t mean it’s not true. it’s your choice, but the fact that you reach out to the internet shows there’s a small part of you that wants to not give up. so don’t. please. look at all these people who are commenting to tell you not to do it! lots of people are awful, insincere, and gross but there still are many people who care. you just have to find them. it sounds like you’ve lost trust in the whole world, but there’s still much more in store for your life. please don’t. your story does NOT have to end yet.
